sourceText: User requires strict completion of Story 6 through every planned wave to DONE, full 3 rounds x 2 hosts (Claude CLI and Codex CLI), no degraded 3x1 authority, no repeated long-process loops, and evidence that the acceptance-topology plan actually prevents late REVIEW omission gaps.
normalizedOutcome: The operator sees a verifier-owned measured Wave 4 rollout report from a frozen real cohort; bounded flat-project enforcement accepts only a current qualifying report plus full 3x2, rollback preserves history, and the canonical plan accurately marks the demonstrated Wave 4 boundary while Wave 3A remains excluded.
acceptanceClaim: A signed/hash-bound real baseline/candidate cohort report meets zero false-pass, zero false-block, non-increasing waiver, non-shrinking check, supported-adapter and full-3x2 thresholds; the production lifecycle consumer rejects missing/stale/tampered/degraded inputs, rollback is non-destructive, role guidance points to canonical facts, and canonical docs match the measured implementation.
